# BlankFX

> Get paid in any stablecoin. BlankFX converts and settles stablecoins within and across currencies on-chain, with published fees and a full audit trail. Non-custodial: users sign every movement from their own wallet.

## Key concepts

- One pool per currency: USD (USDC, USDT, RLUSD, OUSD), EUR (EURC, EURAU, EURI), CHF (CHFAU), SGD (XSGD), JPY (JPYSC, JPYC).
- Same-currency swaps: 1:1 minus a fee (base 0.05% USD pool, 0.10% others, plus up to 1.50% when the bought coin is short).
- Cross-currency swaps: oracle mid-rate (Chainlink EUR/JPY; BlankFX relayed CHF/SGD) adjusted by a PMM pricing curve (k = 0.1), minus the fee. More than 2% from oracle is refused; such tickets go to RFQ.
- Fee split: 80% to pool suppliers, 20% to BlankFX treasury. Transfer fee 0.05% when delivering to another wallet.
- Gasless swaps from $100 via Permit2 + relay router; BlankFX pays gas.
- RFQ: market makers sign firm EIP-712 quotes; taker funds an on-chain escrow; market maker fills.
- Pool share tokens: BFX-USD, BFX-EUR, BFX-CHF, BFX-SGD, BFX-JPY.

## Networks

- Sepolia (testnet): live, chainId 11155111.
- Ethereum (mainnet): planned.
